desc: LWRCI High Flow S-5.56 Suppressor featuring internal gas flow and endcap design was built to mitigate flash, even on shorter barrels, a vented blast chamber and multi-chamber baffle design that strips gas away from the projectile as it passes through the suppressor enhancing inherent precision of the system and a high gas-flow rate blast chamber and baffle design push gas to a vented endcap, allowing gases to exit the suppressor with minimal backpressure to the host rifle.
